text:
eval-bot: Nightly eval alert: 9 suites failing across 3 cohorts for rw-xl-5k-int8 (onboard candidate). Severity: P2.

miguel: Ugh, saw this on the dashboard. failures look concentrated in 'contract-qa' and 'finance-extract' cohorts.

sara: Can someone dump the failing examples? I want to eyeball whether it's hallucinations vs tokenization.

ashley: Pushing a quick repro run now, re-running nightly subset with seed=2026 and fp16 variant for comparison.

liam: Repro command I'm using:```bash
python tools/run_eval.py --model rw-xl-5k-int8 --suites contract-qa,finance-extract,customer-intent --seed 2026 --out /tmp/eval-runs/3270
```

arjun: Heads-up: int8 transform changed kv-cache layout in the runtime patch; might explain prefix mismatches. tagging @miguel for routing.

miguel: Noted. if kv-cache is the culprit we might see blank completions or truncated json. Quick log snippet from a failing trace:```
[2026-03-20 03:12:08] request_id=cb2f - prompt_len=510 - cache_hit=false - generated_tokens=0 - error="kv_cache_mismatch"
```

sara: That log is consistent with the blank outputs. Could be checkpoint mismatch or accidental tokenizer config drift during quant step. Anyone changed tokenizer args on the onboarding script?

ashley: I didn't touch tokenizer. My onboard script used the published tokenization artifact v3. But I will re-run with explicit token config.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: rw-xl-5k-int8 -> stage-slot-3 at rev b4c8. Monitor: https://console/redwood/deploys/b4c8

liam: If stage canary shows same failures, we should switch traffic to rw-xl-5k-fp16 (fallback) and pause onboarding. propose runbook: 1) run targeted eval diff (int8 vs fp16), 2) check kv-cache schema and tokenizer id, 3) roll canary back if reproduces.

arjun: I'll pull the kernel selection logs and the quantization artifact hashes. giving ETA ~25m.

miguel: Assigned owners: @arjun (runtime/quant), @sara (eval/repro), @ashley (onboard scripts). Severity P2 but can go up if more cohorts fail. Keep updates in thread. :thumbsup:

ashley: First repro done. Confirmed blank answers only on int8 variant for long-prefix prompts (>1k tokens). Short prompts ok. Uploading minimal failing example to Gist: https://gist.redwood/3a9f (contains prompt + output).

sara: eyeballing gist: model emits a single newline then stops. tokenizer id in header is "tokenizer:v3". different from server runtime which reports "tokenizer:v3+fast" in canary. mismatch likely.

arjun: Found mismatch: onboarding pipeline accidentally used legacy tokenization wrapper that strips special eos tokens. Hashes: quant artifact h=sha256:aa11 vs runtime expects sha256:bb22. Pushing fix to onboarding packaging now.

miguel: Good find. Plan: publish corrected artifact, re-run targeted evals for the three cohorts, hold canary rollback until we see results. If failures persist after fix, escalate to P1.

deploy-bot: Deploy b4c8 paused (manual hold) by miguel.

ashley: Artifact republished as rw-xl-5k-int8:artifact-20260320-fix. kicking off eval diff.

liam: Thanks. One-off checklist I'm tracking: [x] collect failing examples, [x] repro, [x] identify mismatch, [ ] rerun evals, [ ] canary resume / rollback decision.

miguel: Keep notifications here. If anyone finds other cohorts flaking (e.g., retrieval rerank), flag immediately. Closing loop when all three suites green.

arjun: will post kernel+kv-cache diff once evals finish (~40m).

sara: I'll prepare a short note for the onboarding checklist so this tokenizer artifact check is explicit.

ashley: ETA for eval diffs ~18m.

miguel: Thanks team.
